Yellow Rice with Vienna Sausage

Prep time: 5 minutes
Cook Time: 25 minutes
Yields: 6-8 servings

Ingredients:

  • Goya Adobo - 1 to 2 tablespoons
  • Goya Sofrito Tomato Cooking Base - 6 tablespoons
  • Goya Alcaparrado (pitted) - 3 to 4 tablespoons
  • Goya Sazon - 2 packets
  • Goya Chicken Bouillon - 1 packet
  • Goya Vienna Sausage (Chicken, Beef, & Pork) - 9oz
  • Black Pepper - 1 tablespoon
  • Vegetable Oil - 1oz
  • Carolina Extra Long Grain Enriched Rice - 2 cups
  • Water - 2 1/2 cups

Prep Work:

  • Wash rice and put to the side
  • Slice up Vienna Sausage links preserving the liquid (do not throw out)
  • Measure out Sofrito
  • Measure out Alcaparrado
  • Measure out water

Instructions:

1) In a medium sauce pan on HIGH heat put in vegitable oil and work it around the pan.
2) Stir in the Sofrito and Alcaparrado and let them simmer for a minute.
3) Pour in liquid from Vienna Sausage can with the sliced up Vienna Sausage. Stir.
4) Put rice into pan first then the sazon, adobo, bouillon, and pepper.
5) Pour in water and stir mixing everything up.
6) Let boil on HIGH heat for a 3-4 minutes. Much of the water should begin to be soaked into the rice.
7) Stir one last time and COVER.
8) Reduce heat to LOW. Set timer for 25 minutes.
9) Enjoy
